title: Financial Responsibility Filings (SR-22 / FR-44): Type Charge on a Moved Certificate
content:
A transfer type charge is added to the moved certificate fee under Financial Responsibility Filings (SR-22 / FR-44). A moved certificate is the state-change refiling a named insured orders after moving. The charge follows the certificate type, which fixes the kind of new term the certificate rests on.

| Certificate on the new term | Transfer type charge |
|---|---|
| Owner-Operator certificate on an Owner Auto Policy new term | 4.00 |
| Operator certificate on a Named Non-Owner Policy new term | 2.00 |
| Owner certificate | none |

*Hypothetical:*

- An SR-22 Owner-Operator Certificate moved onto a new Owner Auto Policy term: 4.00.
- An FR-44 Owner Certificate moved onto a new Owner Auto Policy term: no type charge.
